name: Weblium
description_en:
Weblium is a hosted visual website builder with Starter for lead-generation/business sites and Business for stores, blogs and multilingual sites. Its current pricing structure replaces the older Free/Pro model with Free, Starter and Business. Template-based editing, integrations and custom code have plan-specific limits, while done-for-you Studio and White Label are separate offers.

Free publishing is now time-limited. The official pricing-change announcement gives new sites 14 trial days plus 46 Free days online, after which a paid subscription is needed. Evaluate the continuing subscription and migration terms rather than treating the footer’s “free website builder” description as indefinite free hosting.
description_zh:
Weblium 是托管可视化建站工具，Starter 面向获客/企业站，Business 面向商店、博客和多语言站。当前定价从旧 Free/Pro 改为 Free、Starter、Business，模板编辑、集成和自定义代码按档设限，代建 Studio 与 White Label 是独立服务。

免费发布现有限期。官方价格更新公告给新站 14 天试用加 46 天 Free 在线期，之后需要付费订阅。应评估持续费用与迁移条款，不能将页脚“免费建站工具”描述当作无限期免费托管。

core_features.explanation_en: Starter adds SEO, lead tools, layout customization, integrations and custom code, with 10 pages, 3GB media and 5GB bandwidth listed.
core_features.explanation_zh: Starter 增加 SEO、获客工具、布局定制、集成和自定义代码，列出 10 页、3GB 媒体和 5GB 带宽。

core_features.explanation_en: Business adds store/blog and up to five language versions, with up to 500 pages, 10GB media and 20GB bandwidth listed.
core_features.explanation_zh: Business 增加商店/博客和最多五种语言，列出最多 500 页、10GB 媒体和 20GB 带宽。

core_features.explanation_en: New sites have 14-day full-feature trial plus 46 days on Free; unpublished data is kept another 60 days before permanent deletion.
core_features.explanation_zh: 新站先有 14 天完整功能试用，再有 46 天 Free，下线后数据再保留 60 天才永久删除。

pricing.summary_en: Starter $16/month or $132/year; Business $25/month or $210/year, per site. Free publishing is limited to 60 days for new sites including the trial; bundles, Studio and White Label separate.
pricing.summary_zh: Starter $16/月或 $132/年，Business $25/月或 $210/年，按站计费。新站免费公开含试用仅 60 天，站点包、Studio、White Label 另计。

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from the attached primary sources. Vendor documentation does not establish independent testing or customer outcomes.
Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.title_en: Match the site to the revised plans
sections.en: Start with the full-feature 14-day no-card trial and test a representative page, lead form and desired integration. Starter is the documented choice for lead collection without online selling; Business adds payments/store, blog and up to five site languages. A trial can expose Business features that Starter does not keep, so compare required behavior before selecting a lower plan. Free is limited to three pages, 100MB storage/bandwidth and the announced publication deadline. The online-store functionality does not establish every payment method, country, inventory or processor fee; those require a separate store-specific evaluation.
sections.zh: 可从 14 天免卡完整功能试用开始，验证代表页面、线索表单和目标集成。Starter 对应不在线销售的获客场景，Business 增加支付/商店、博客和最多五种站点语言。试用可能开放 Starter 不保留的 Business 功能，选择较低方案前应核对必需行为。Free 限三页、100MB 存储/带宽及公告发布期限。具有商店功能不证明支持每种支付方式、国家、库存行为或处理费，需另作商店专项评估。

sections.title_en: Price each website and separate service bundles
sections.title_zh: 按网站核价并区分服务包
sections.en: The current pricing FAQ and official change announcement agree on USD Starter $16/month or $132/year ($11 monthly equivalent), and Business $25/month or $210/year ($17.50 equivalent). The main price cards remained XX placeholders in the text capture, so use the explicit FAQ/announcement rather than inventing a rendered card amount. Each subscription covers one website; 5/10/15-site bundles have separate discounts. Annual plans include a first-year domain with plan-dependent eligible extensions. Studio starts at $300 for a service engagement; White Label starts at $48/month, not the ordinary single-site fee. The old-price purchase window ended September 2, 2026 and is not a current discount. Check taxes, renewal and extras at checkout.
sections.zh: 当前定价 FAQ 与官方更新公告一致：美元 Starter $16/月或 $132/年（月均 $11），Business $25/月或 $210/年（月均 $17.50）。文本读取中的主价格卡仍为 XX 占位，因此使用明确 FAQ/公告，不编造渲染卡金额。每份订阅覆盖一个网站，5/10/15 站套餐另有折扣。年付含首年域名，可用后缀取决于方案。Studio 服务起价 $300，White Label 起价 $48/月，均不是普通单站费。旧价购买窗口已于 2026 年 9 月 2 日结束，不能作为当前优惠。税费、续费和附加项需结账确认。

sections.title_en: Account for the new Free deadline and data deletion
sections.title_zh: 计算 Free 新期限和数据删除
sections.en: The announcement says new sites move from 14-day trial to Free for another 46 days, totaling 60 days available before a paid plan is needed. When that publishing period ends the site goes offline; data is kept 60 additional days and then permanently deleted unless a paid plan is activated. Existing pre-change Free sites had separate transition rules, so do not apply the new-site clock to every old project. Older Pro subscriptions move to Business after the paid term under new limits/pricing. Verify the exact account deadline and retain independent content copies. This is not a sustained-free tier and the finite data hold is not an export or backup guarantee.
sections.zh: 公告称新站从 14 天试用转为 Free 46 天，总计 60 天可公开，之后需付费。发布期结束网站下线，数据额外保留 60 天，未付费则永久删除。改价前既有免费站有独立过渡规则，不能将新站时钟套用于所有旧项目。旧 Pro 付费期结束后按新版限制/价格转为 Business。应确认实际账户截止并另存内容。它不是持续免费档，有限数据保留也不等于导出或备份保证。

sections.title_en: Connect domains with the mail dependency visible
sections.title_zh: 连接域名时检查邮件依赖
sections.en: The domain article offers nameserver delegation or A-record connection through Site Settings → Domains → Connect an external domain. Delegation moves DNS management to Weblium; existing mail and other services stop until their records are recreated there. Keeping DNS management and adding the instructed A records is the alternative when preserving MX/TXT/subdomain services matters. The guide allows 24–48 hours for propagation and temporary failed status. It still calls eligibility “Pro sites only” despite the new Starter/Business structure; confirm current plan entitlement and its account-level external-domain formula before changing DNS. No DNS was modified here.
sections.zh: 域名文章提供 nameserver 委派或 A 记录连接，入口为 Site Settings → Domains → Connect an external domain。委派将 DNS 管理移至 Weblium，原有邮件等服务会在对应记录重建前停止。需要保留 MX/TXT/子域名服务时，可保留 DNS 管理并按指示添加 A 记录。指南允许 24–48 小时传播及临时失败状态。它仍称仅 Pro 可用，与新 Starter/Business 结构不一致，应先确认当前方案资格及账户外部域名数量公式再改 DNS。本次没有修改 DNS。

sections.title_zh: 续费、降级及运营适用性
sections.en: The pricing FAQ says plans auto-renew unless disabled; a failed renewal receives five days of paid-feature grace before switching to Free. This does not override Free’s newer publication/deletion deadlines, so confirm account status promptly. Upgrades credit unused time; downgrades require stopping auto-renewal and buying the lower plan after the current term. Weblium is a plausible option for a managed small-business site or store that fits its limits. Complete code export, independent self-hosting, rollback scope and open-source licensing were not established by these sources. Studio’s migration/search-preservation claims are vendor promises, not tested outcomes. No account, store transaction, form, migration or recovery was executed.
sections.zh: 定价 FAQ 称未关闭时自动续费；扣款失败有五天付费功能宽限，之后转为 Free。这不覆盖新版 Free 发布/删除期限，应及时确认账户状态。升级会按未用时间调整费用，降级要求先停自动续费，在当前期结束后购买低档。符合限额的托管小企业站或商店可考虑 Weblium。这些来源未确立完整代码导出、独立自托管、回滚范围或开源许可。Studio 关于迁移/保留搜索表现的描述是厂商承诺，未实测结果。本次未执行账户、商店交易、表单、迁移或恢复。

research_gaps.en: Current domain entitlement uses legacy Pro wording; tax/renewal checkout, store/payment fees, bundle conditions, code/data export and recovery need confirmation.

research_gaps.zh: 未实测实际账户 Free 截止、付费降级、域名连接、支付或迁移。
